signature.encoding: UTF-8, LF separators, no final LF
components: exact public request path and query
lowercase SHA256 hex of exact body bytes
signature.contractHash: SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of this file

routes.GET /snapshots/{id}?cursor={cursor}: Snapshot page from same immutable snapshot

ownership.displayName: trimmed, 1..200 Unicode code points, no control characters
ownership.mserpOwnerDriverId: required nullable UUID, non-null exactly when kind is driver
ownership.semantics: Complete replacement when present; required on initial truck creation/link. Never changes assignments or insurance. Driver owner need not have a local FleetScope driver link. Independent investor is never lease.

semantics.operation: Strict typed JSON, unknown fields rejected. See sync.go wire structs and docs/FLEETSCOPE_SYNC_WIRE.md for exact fields. Replay same operationId and exact bytes returns committed original Result. Different bytes returns 409. Mutation, external identity, revision and receipt commit atomically.
semantics.truck: Per-truck strictly increasing sourceRevision. Source IDs are namespaced by company/environment/epoch. Linking requires reviewed snapshotId, expectedRevision and remote ID. No implicit VIN adoption. Upsert existing uses external identity. Provisioning is create-only color/class/GVWR, never ownership. operationalActive cannot remove a receiver safety hold.
semantics.assignment: Strict company assignmentSequence, initial value 1. Complete desired crews only for explicitly listed trucks. Validate expectedRevision for each crew and all linked driver identities. Empty primary/secondary releases. All affected crews apply atomically; no implicit eviction outside the list. Return complete resulting crews with NEW expectedRevision values. Trailers stay on trucks. No ownership or employment side effects. Repeated unchanged baseline is allowed as a versioned adoption.
semantics.retire: Must be unassigned, retain history and external identity tombstone, return remote ID and revision.
semantics.snapshot: Stable id/capturedAt/epoch/company/environment across pages. nextCursor empty at end. Trucks include assignmentRevision even when unassigned, current ownership JSON and projection (complete current MSERP-owned field values; null only before binding). Include retired linked trucks and terminated linked drivers. No SSN, birthdate, payroll or documents.
semantics.bootstrap: driver.link without hireEventId and truck.link require bootstrap credentials and snapshot preconditions. driver.link with hireEventId can use live enrollment scope for the first binding to that emitted hire only.
semantics.errors: Non-2xx JSON contains code, never sensitive details. 409 conflict, 422 invalid, 401/403 auth, 429 throttled, 503 transient. Retry-After integer seconds supported. No redirects.
